behaviour_summary: pi0 goes to the mug instead of the book and stalls with the gripper on the mug rim for ~330 steps without ever lifting it.

failures.mode_definition: The policy grasps a different-category distractor object instead of the instructed object and runs the transport/place motion with it.
hl_remedy: REPROMPT "pick up the book and place it in the front compartment of the caddy"
WATCH 5 s for an approach to the book
failures.prevention: Coordinator grounds the target object before running pi0 and the FR agent HALTs when the EE descends on a non-target object; a dark book standing against the dark caddy may need an explicit VERIFY of the target's location.
failures.observation: At 40-60 the arm moves to the image-left; from 80 to 409 the gripper sits on the mug rim with the fingers inside/around the rim and never lifts; the mug only shifts slightly. The book, upright to the right of the mug, is never touched.

notes: Off-task, the mug grasp also stalls (gripper on the rim, no lift); not recorded as a task failure.
